title: Oven Crisp Thai Mushrooms Tom Kha
description: A yeasty, crisp, and light Thai dish featuring salt and air-fry techniques, this ovo-vegetarian friendly recipe is a twist on traditional Tom Kha, a central Thai coconut-based soup.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together coconut milk, vegetable oil, salt, Thai red curry paste, and lemon juice.
Add the mushrooms to the bowl and toss to coat with the curry mixture.
In a separate bowl, beat the eggs.
Add the panko breadcrumbs to a third bowl.
Dip each mushroom into the eggs, then coat in panko breadcrumbs.
Place the coated mushrooms on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the mushrooms in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro and serve hot.
